deadlines.what_en: File the claim to establish the right (main claim) within 8 days of the attachment decision of 9 Sep 2026, or the attachment is deemed void (Civil Procedure Law Article 250(2); the decision day is not counted, Article 12(1); 17 Sep 2026 is a Thursday, a working day). The handwritten decision gives the period, not the date. The claim dated 14 Sep and registered 15 Sep 2026 is within it.

claims.item_en: Confirm the provisional attachment ordered in application no. 412/2026
Principal: value of the three returned cheques
Delay interest at 5% a year from each cheque's due date
Court fees, costs and lawyer's fees

key_facts.fact_en: Under a supply agreement of 10 Feb 2026 the defendant gave the claimant three cheques drawn on Al Kuthban National Bank: no. 000731 for AED 96,400 (15 Jun 2026), no. 000732 for AED 112,750 (15 Jul 2026) and no. 000733 for AED 88,600 (15 Aug 2026), total AED 297,750

Cheques 000731 and 000732 came back for insufficient funds and cheque 000733 for a signature mismatch; the bank wrote a dated return statement on each cheque and reported the two insufficient-funds cheques to the Central Bank

On 9 Sep 2026 the summary judge ordered a provisional attachment of the defendant's balances with banks operating in the UAE up to AED 297,750, and required the applicant to file the claim to establish the right within 8 days of the decision, failing which the attachment is void
The claim asks the court to confirm the attachment and to order payment of AED 297,750 with 5% a year interest, fees and costs

reader_should_flag: Article 350 of the Civil Procedure Law does not exist (the law has 338 articles); the costs request should rely on Article 133.
'المواد (663-665) من قانون المعاملات التجارية' is a range: it cites Articles 663, 664 and 665, all valid and all on recourse against the drawer after payment is refused.

The main claim had to be filed within 8 days of the attachment decision of 9 Sep 2026, so by 17 Sep 2026 (Civil Procedure Law Article 250(2)), or the attachment is void; the claim dated 14 Sep and registered 15 Sep 2026 was filed in time.
The attachment order and the 8-day period appear only in the judge's handwritten decision on page 3.

Cheque 000733 was returned for a signature mismatch, not for lack of funds, so unlike the other two it is not an executive instrument under Article 667 of the Commercial Transactions Law; the drawer may contest that signature.
